title: Toasts from useAppNotification must be asserted via the mocked hook, not the DOM
answers: How do I test that a success/error toast was shown?
Why doesn't screen.findByText find my toast message?
How to assert app notifications in RTL tests?
body: Toasts raised through `useAppNotification()` (e.g. `notifyApp.success(...)`) never render into the DOM tree under test — they go through the app notification system. To assert them, `jest.mock('app/core/copy/appNotification')` and provide a mocked return value (`{ success: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn(), warning: jest.fn(), info: jest.fn() }`), then assert the jest.fn() was called with the expected title/body args instead of querying screen text.
applies: Any RTL test for a component that calls useAppNotification() to show toasts.
says: Show a confirmation toast notification after successfully importing the alert manager configuration.

search: Toasts from useAppNotification() do not render into the DOM—they go through the app notification system and cannot be queried via screen/getByText. Mock app/core/copy/appNotification with jest.mock() and provide a mocked return object ({ success: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn(), warning: jest.fn(), info: jest.fn() }), then assert the jest.fn() was called with the expected title/body arguments instead of asserting DOM content. This pattern is essential for RTL tests of any component calling useAppNotification() to show toasts, as demonstrated in public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/import-to-gma/steps/Step1AlertmanagerResources.test.tsx.
